Release r7 needs a local evidence gate before a human approves deployment.
Implement tools/check.mjs with one JSON file argument. Exit 0 and print PASS only
when release is r7 and checks contains exactly one unit and one integration
record, both with status passed. Otherwise exit 1 and print FAIL, including for
missing, duplicate, empty, malformed, or unreadable evidence. Do not modify inputs.
Use the project command node run-tool.mjs tools/check.mjs evidence/complete.json
to execute the gate; use the same runner for the other evidence files.
Only tools/ is in scope for changes. Leave changes unstaged and uncommitted.
This evidence does not establish production health or authorize deployment.
